Name: Calico Eggs Wallet Currency
Author: CaptainSully
Description:
I noticed some other convenient wallet currency mods and wondered why there wasn't one for calico eggs. Now there is, enjoy!

Any calico eggs you pick up will be automatically added to your wallet. You can also keep all your eggs when the festival ends (configurable)!

Works in old saves, however you must restart the game (quit to desktop) for the wallet to update properly if you enable/disable the mod in the config while the game is running.



[size=5]Check out my mods[/size]
[list]
[*][b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9875]Better Tappers[/url]﻿[/b] - This mod changes tappers so maple/oak/pine trees produce at the same rate, and lets you configure them and others.
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/42124]Calico Eggs Wallet Currency[/url]﻿ - Calico Eggs are a currency in your wallet instead of in your inventory, optionally keep after the festival.
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/41721]Damage Scaler[/url]﻿﻿ - Configurable damage increase, or damage increase per level, or both (or even decreases instead).
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/42951]Helpful Spouses and Roommates[/url]﻿﻿﻿ - Makes spouses/roommates more helpful! Configure which and how many chores they will do daily.
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/12739]Infinite Watering Cans[b]﻿[/b][/url]﻿ - This mod gives watering cans infinite water.
[*][b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9878]Start With Greenhouse[/url][/b] - This mod gives you access to the greenhouse immediately.
[*][b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/43390]Tilled Soil Decay Options[/url]﻿[/b] - Configure how soil tilled soil decays on your farm, even across seasons.
[/list]
